title: happy's: a concept site for a downtown Cary cocktail bar
tag: Concept site · cocktail bar and event space, Cary, NC
summaryLead: A concept site for a downtown Cary cocktail bar. Not a launched project.
summaryMore: One hand-written HTML file built around the bar's smiley wall: cream and tomato, heavy lowercase type.

stack.name: Delivery
stack.detail: One self-contained HTML file. No framework, build step or database.

stack.name: Accessibility
stack.detail: HTML5 landmarks, a native dialog with focus return, aria-pressed toggles.

stack.name: Type
stack.detail: Bricolage Grotesque, Hanken Grotesk and Space Mono.

stack.name: Menu
stack.detail: 60 items in ten sections as data, with chips, search and one delegated click handler.

stack.name: Walk up
stack.detail: Twelve CSS-only 3D steps inside a native dialog.

stack.name: Forms
stack.detail: Sign-up is front-end only in this concept.

chapters.title: A menu that is fun to use
chapters.challenge: Sixty items across ten sections is a wall of text on a phone.
chapters.solution: Colour-coded cards with chips, search and a running "tab (for fun)".
chapters.outcome: Quick to scan and easy to keep current.

chapters.title: The walk up climb
chapters.challenge: "The walk up" is part of the bar's identity, and a plain link would not carry it.
chapters.solution: A CSS-only 3D staircase in a native dialog, skipped for reduced motion.
chapters.outcome: A memorable moment with no video or library.

chapters.title: Hours that stay current
chapters.challenge: Hours are irregular, and visitors want one clear answer.
chapters.solution: Hours stored as data and checked against Eastern time.
chapters.outcome: One answer in the nav, with no manual updates.

results.title: Personality
results.text: The page borrows the bar's smiley wall and type.

results.title: Practical answers
results.text: Menu, hours and address are never far away.

results.title: Respects motion settings
results.text: The climb, confetti and cursor are skipped for reduced motion.
